title: Women Who Draw No Line
note: This is the nature of women who sell their charms to anyone who pays, drawing no line between the fit and the unfit. It follows the faults that come from a man’s own wife.

couplets.plain: The sweet words of women in fine bangles, who want wealth and not love, will bring you down.
couplets.pm: Women who want a man not for love but for wealth speak sweetly, as if for love, until it is in their hands. Those sweet words bring him pain later. Their fine bangles and sweet words are their tools. The words seem sweet for the moment, then bring poverty, so don’t take them in.
couplets.sensitive: Portrays sex workers as mercenary deceivers

links.quote: who want wealth and not love
links.reason: Describes them by what they want: wealth and not love.

couplets.plain: Women without virtue weigh what they can get and talk of their virtue. Weigh their ways and keep away.
couplets.pm: Women without virtue measure what a man has, and speak of their own virtue until they get it. Weigh how they live, and leave them without joining them. Their virtue is in their words, not in them. For them this is the duty of their caste, as you learn from their acts as well as from books, and knowing this is the way to leave them.
couplets.sensitive: Portrays paid women as scheming; advises shunning them

links.quote: Weigh their ways and keep away
links.reason: Takes talk of virtue with an eye to gain as their mark, and says to keep away.

couplets.plain: The false embrace of women who want only wealth is like embracing a stranger’s corpse in a dark room.
couplets.pm: The false embrace of common women, who want the wealth and not the giver, is like a corpse-bearer embracing an unknown corpse in a dark room. A woman embracing for wealth a man unsuited to her in caste and age feels what a hired bearer feels lifting a stranger’s corpse in an unseen place. She shrinks within and embraces without. So give this up.
couplets.sensitive: Likens a sex worker's embrace to a corpse

links.reason: Names the paid embrace as false, like holding a stranger’s corpse in the dark.

couplets.plain: Those whose understanding looks to compassion won’t touch the cheap charms of women who look only to wealth.
couplets.pm: These women scorn pleasure and want only wealth. Those of understanding, who seek out and practise what goes with compassion, won’t touch their cheap charms. Righteousness and the rest are all called aims, so he marks these two as the aim of wealth and the aim of compassion. Such charms are fit only for the low, and are opposed to the righteousness these people want.

links.reason: Those who look to compassion are known by keeping clear of a bought embrace.

couplets.plain: Those whose understanding is made great by a good mind won’t touch the cheap charms of women who are common to all.
couplets.pm: Those whose learned understanding is made fine by a naturally good mind won’t touch the cheap charms of women whose desire is common to all who pay. A good mind means clearness of heart, which comes from good deeds in earlier births. Without it learning doesn’t grow fine. To such understanding, the commonness of their desire and the cheapness of their bodies are plain.
couplets.sensitive: Treats women open to all as defiling

links.quote: won’t touch the cheap charms of women who are common to all
links.reason: A good mind joined to understanding is what holds people back here.

couplets.plain: Those who spread their own goodness won’t touch the shoulders of women who, proud of their looks, spread their cheap charms about.
couplets.pm: Women drunk on their dancing, singing and beauty spread their cheap charms to anyone who pays. The great, who should spread through the world their fame for understanding and conduct, won’t touch their shoulders. Those three gifts are the women’s distinction. Touching them destroys understanding and conduct, so those who win fame by these keep clear.
couplets.sensitive: Uses contemptuous language for sex workers

links.quote: Those who spread their own goodness
links.reason: Those who spread their own goodness are said to stay out of paid embraces.
Pictures the woman as spreading her cheap charms about.

couplets.plain: Those without a steady heart will touch the shoulders of women who join their bodies while their hearts want something else.
couplets.pm: These women want other things at heart and, for those things, join bodily with whoever gives. Those whose hearts aren’t made firm by self-command touch their shoulders. Their hearts are set on wealth and what it buys, so all that joins is the body. People whose hearts know this and don’t run that way keep clear.
couplets.sensitive: Demeans sex workers as bodies without feeling

couplets.plain: They say that to those without sharp understanding, the embrace of deceitful women is a deadly spirit’s touch.
couplets.pm: The learned say that to those without the understanding to see through it, the embrace of women skilled in deceiving by looks, words and acts is the touch of a goddess who takes life through desire. It seems sweet at first and then takes your life. It is put in the mouths of the learned to show it is their settled view.
couplets.sensitive: Casts women as wily spirits who ensnare men

links.reason: Those without sharp understanding are struck by such embraces as by a deadly spirit.

couplets.plain: The soft shoulders of finely jewelled women who draw no line are the mire of hell where worthless low men sink.
couplets.pm: The soft shoulders of women who embrace anyone who pays, high or low, are the hell into which base people sink, who lack the understanding to see this fault. That understanding raises you, so it is called worth. “Worthless” sets these men apart from those low by caste. The shoulders are made hell itself because they lead there directly.
couplets.sensitive: Compares a sex worker to a filthy ditch

links.quote: the mire of hell where worthless low men sink
links.reason: Makes those shoulders the mire of hell where only worthless low men sink.

links.quote: soft shoulders of finely jewelled women
links.reason: Begins with their jewels and soft shoulders, and turns them into the danger.

couplets.plain: Women of two hearts, liquor and dice are the friends of those whom prosperity has left.
couplets.pm: Women of divided heart, liquor and dice: these three are the friends of those abandoned by the goddess of prosperity. A divided heart both joins a man and doesn’t, at the same time. Liquor and gambling are named with them as faults of the same kind, and the next chapters follow this order. These are the signs that prosperity has left someone.
couplets.sensitive: Ranks women of divided heart among the signs of a ruined man

links.reason: Women of two hearts come first among the friends of those prosperity has left.
The dice close the list of friends left to those prosperity has abandoned.
